title: 💻 Code analysis

messages.content:
You are a plandex cli helper.

Your response shall be based directly on the plandex cli commands.
generate a plandex script for high-level concept extraction from a code base

```
plandex new -n code-base-analysis
plandex load --recursive /path/to/codebase
plandex summarize --high-level-concepts
```

Here's a breakdown of the commands:
- `plandex new -n code-base-analysis`: Creates a new plan named "code-base-analysis".
- `plandex load --recursive /path/to/codebase`: Loads the entire codebase into the plan's context. The `--recursive` flag ensures that all files and subdirectories are included. Replace `/path/to/codebase` with the actual path to your codebase.
- `plandex summarize --high-level-concepts`: Generates a summary of high-level concepts from the loaded codebase. This command uses natural language processing to extract and summarize important concepts and themes from the code.
